info.title: Vuuut Click API
info.description: Independent Rust analytics SaaS. Cookie mutations require exact PUBLIC_URL Origin. Website read keys authorize reports; integration keys authorize backend events and native connector control. Stripe webhooks require verified provider signatures. Native v1 provisioning and pinned-key staff exchange are implemented; see GHOST_INTEGRATION.md.

post.description: Profile requires display_name. Other actions require current_password. Password requires new_password and a fresh code when MFA is enabled. Confirm, codes and disable require code. put.summary: Apply a versioned native tenant snapshot
put.description: Same revision and exact body returns the same mapping and website integration credential; stale/conflicting snapshots return 409. Deletion is terminal and durable.

post.summary: Pin the verified CMS issuer and RSA JWKS
post.description: Exact verified website origin issuer only. One to four distinct RS256 RSA public keys, minimum 2048 bits. Identical retries preserve access; changed keys revoke prior native sessions.

post.summary: Exchange a dedicated signed CMS staff assertion
post.description: Requires RS256 pinned signature, dedicated issuer/audience, Owner or Administrator role, matching website, time bounds and one-use jti. Returns access_token, token_type, expires_in=60 and website_id. Does not mint a customer or owner cookie.

post.summary: Replace a website integration credential
post.description: Persist a random 32-byte hex replacement before sending; recover a lost response by reconnecting with that replacement. Revokes old delegated sessions.

post.summary: Revoke a native connector and delegated access
post.description: An identical retry can confirm an already committed disconnect using only its matching revoked credential.

post.summary: Verify the current website DNS TXT challenge
post.description: Checks _vuuut-click.<host> for the exact verification challenge and rechecks credential/origin under the commit lock.

post.summary: Accept a raw-body-signed native CMS event
post.description: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + period + raw body with the integration credential; timestamp send window is 5 minutes past / 60 seconds future. Preserves original event time and idempotency. Maximum 16 KiB.

get.description: Eight authoritative backend event kinds are counted independently of top-list truncation. Optional local path groups slash/non-slash aliases for one CMS post. Replay-safe raw queries; website-only read authorization and report budgets apply.

post.summary: Record or revise a supplied advertising cost with provenance
post.description: Manager session with exact Origin, or website integration credential. Reuse source/reference and revision for replay; a correction increments revision. Conflicts return 409. References are hashed; daily rows expire with website retention and cascade on deletion. Up to 50,000 retained records per website. No charge/provider call occurs.
